postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 1 and 200,000.
Each ancestor in the array b is a valid vertex number.
Each vertex in the permutation p is a valid vertex number.

postconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
postconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

invariants.expression: The tree specified by b is a connected undirected graph without cycles.
invariants.description: The tree structure is valid and connected.

invariants.expression: The root of the tree has no ancestor, so b_i = i for the root.
The permutation p represents a valid order of vertices by their distance from the root.
invariants.description: The permutation must be achievable with the given tree structure and edge weights.
